name: r032_prepared_camp_patrol_v1
description: Disposable R-032 Patrol footing.  It retains the established camp's existing Food, Storage, and Locker zones and adds one single-tile CAMP_PATROL zone at a known passable camp tile.  The zone transform is setup-only; native job-priority assignment, runtime ownership/position, elapsed time, and priority-zero release are separately required for any Patrol conclusion.
